Because pending_extraction contributed to the stop pressure, the controller could stop the only process able to drain the pending historical backlog.

hypothesis: Backpressure must preserve the shared extraction-carrying fabric and suppress raw research at scheduling/prompt allocation boundaries rather than killing the process that performs historical extraction.
counterhypothesis: Process-level stop is safe because historical extraction has an independent transport.
